recentItems.title: CHHATH MAAI GHATVA JHALIYA TANGAIL | KALPANA | RAJESH GUPTA | BHOJPURI CHHATH GEET
recentItems.description:
Immerse yourself in the devotion and traditions of Chhath Puja with “Chhath Maai Ghatva JHaliya Tangail”, a beautiful Bhojpuri devotional song sung by the melodious Kalpana. Featuring music composed by Rajesh Gupta and lyrics written by Vinay Bihari, this traditional Chhath Geet celebrates the faith, rituals and heartfelt devotion associated with Chhathi Maiya.

Let this soulful melody bring the spirit of Chhath celebrations into your home. Enjoy this devotional Bhojpuri classic with your family and celebrate the blessings of Chhathi Maiya.

छठ घाट के पावन माहौल, पूजा के तैयारी आ छठी मइया के प्रति अटूट श्रद्धा के एह गीत में महसूस करीं। परिवार के संगे एह भक्तिमय गीत के सुनीं आ छठी मइया के भक्ति में लीन हो जाईं।
